title: Workcloud Sync
description:
Zebra Workcloud Sync provides a unified and secure solutionpurpose-built for the front line. From one single application, equip your front line with push-to-talk, voice-and-video calling, multimedia messaging, and task management, making information and co-workers immediately accessible. That’s how you engage and encourage your workers to be their most efficient and effective.

Push-to-Talk
Real-Time Collaboration Across Your Frontline
With Push-to-Talk, transform your mobile devices into feature-rich walkie-talkies, enhancing communication by making it easy to reach the right employee at the right time.

Voice and Video Calling
Real-Time Voice and Video Collaboration
With Voice and Video Calling, streamline information sharing and enable effective, synchronous communication for your frontline workforce.

Chat
Multimedia Messaging to Connect Your Workforce
Boost workforce agility with real-time messaging capabilities, allowing seamless 1:1 and group communication using text, images, audio, and video.

Forums
Empower Frontline Staff Through Priority Communication
With Forums, ensure your workforce has access to the latest information with the ability to view and post broad communication.

To-Dos
Streamline Activities With To-Do Lists
Ensure that your frontline employees know what needs to be accomplished at any time with To-Dos, improving productivity and driving a better customer experience.

PBX Calling
Easily Connect with External Vendors and Customers
Bridge communication gaps with PBX Calling, allowing frontline workers to take external calls anytime, anywhere.

Learn more at:
https://www.zebra.com/us/en/software/workcloud-solutions/workcloud-enterprise-collaboration-suite/workcloud-sync.html
